rounds: Two weeks of same-same routine gear to work — Joy Police held the line there, kept things familiar and safe. And then the Apollo ring moment: a colleague opened a door and you closed it. That one stings a little. The ring was already on your finger. That part was yours. The conversation didn't have to be.
pattern: They're letting you wear the things but shutting down any moment someone actually notices.
focus: One nosy question, one honest answer — doesn't have to be the whole story, just one true thing
